claims.text: Gusto positions itself as the 'leading partner for small businesses'
Gusto's homepage leads with 'Payroll, HR, Benefits. Simplified.'
Gusto claims customers save 152 hours per year on average on tax and compliance by switching to Gusto
A Gusto customer (Kevin Michael Gray, Approveme.com) reports payroll now takes less than one hour per month, down from one full day per month
Gusto plans start at $49/mo + $6/mo per person
Gusto calls itself 'one of the most affordable payroll and HR platforms on the market'
Gusto has 500,000+ small and medium-sized business customers
9 out of 10 Gusto customers would recommend Gusto, per a survey of 538 Gusto customers conducted September 2024
Gusto's core payroll product is designed for US-based businesses; it does not natively support Canadian payroll
Gusto offers Canada EOR via a third-party partnership with Remote
Gusto offers an international contractor add-on for paying international contractors
Gusto launched Gusto Cofounder, an agentic AI tool, on June 2, 2026
Gusto Cofounder is described as launching with pre-loaded context from a business's team, payroll schedule, benefits, and compliance calendar
Gusto Cofounder is positioned as differentiated from 'general-purpose AI tools that start from a blank slate'
Gusto Cofounder can be accessed via SMS or Slack
Gusto Cofounder was built in eleven weeks by a team of five
Gusto announced nearly 75 product updates as part of its Spring 2026 Showcase on April 23, 2026
Gusto now integrates natively with ChatGPT, Claude, and Slack
Gusto surpassed $1 billion in trailing 12-month revenue, announced May 7, 2026
Gusto reported five consecutive quarters of accelerating revenue growth as of May 2026
Gusto launched Gusto Money in October 2025, including a Payroll Bridge line of credit, invoicing, and bill pay
Gusto launched level-funded health plans claiming an average 20% savings on health insurance premiums
Gusto launched Gusto 401(k) powered by Guideline
Gusto launched Payroll Hub for accountants — a consolidated client payroll dashboard
Gusto published a report stating Gen Z entrepreneurs now outnumber Baby Boomers in new business starts
Gusto California, Inc. has Google ads that have been running continuously for between 782 and 1,414 days
Gusto's international coverage is limited: core payroll is US-only, Canada EOR is via third-party Remote, and there is an international contractor add-on
Gusto Cofounder's AI context is limited to Gusto's own product surface (payroll, benefits, compliance) and does not span IT or finance spend management
Gusto describes its mission as 'taking hats off their head, doing work on their behalf' for small businesses
Gusto's Spring 2026 Showcase included updates across payroll automation, financial intelligence, AI-powered tools, and mobile
